{{Quote|This system is within the patrol region of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet. That makes it Chiss territory. Number two: the Vagaari arrived in force with the clear intent of causing harm. That makes Commander Thrawn's actions self-defense, as far as I'm concerned.|[[Jorj Car'das]]|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
An [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] '''star system''' contained a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Star/Legends|sun]] as well as an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. A small but impressive globular [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] was visible from the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It was situated on a straight-line path between the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]'s [[Roxuli system/Legends|Roxuli system]] and the [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (destruction of Special Task Force One)|site]] of a first Unknown Regions' scheduled [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] check of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colony ship/Legends|colonization vessel]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''.<ref name="Outbound" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> the star system was the site of an [[Battle for Outbound Flight|attack]] on the ''Outbound Flight''.<ref name="Outbound" />
